create_channel: create a new channel with name, type, and optional group or user members
get_channels_by_user: get all channels accessible to a user including group, dm, and standard channels
add_members_to_channel: add multiple users or groups as members to an existing channel
join_leave_channel: join or leave a channel and manage active membership status
create_channel_webhook: create a webhook for a channel with a generated secret token
